The Oxford Book of Canadian Verse

Songs of the Sea Children: VI. ‘Love, by that loosened hair’

Bliss Carman (1861–1929)

L
OVE,
 by that loosened hair,
Well now I know
Where the lost Lilith went
So long ago.
Love, by those starry eyes
I understand
How the sea maidens lure
Mortals from land.
Love, by that welling laugh
Joy claims its own
Sea-born and wind-wayward
Child of the sun.
